title: Noah Kahan Announces Dates For 2027 Last of the Bugs World Tour
summary: Next year's stadium run is slated to kick off on April 24 in Athens, Ga. at Sanford Stadium.
contentText:
Noah Kahan is gearing up for a major 2027 tour. On Thursday morning (Oct. 29) the “Stick Season” singer announced the dates for his expansive 2027 The Last of the Bugs World Tour, which will feature stadium shows from Athens, Ga. to Paris, France.

Related

Hayden Panettiere's Death Ruled as Accidental, Case Closed: Reports

Noah Kahan Talks Landing Lead Single For ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Soundtrack: ‘You’re Not Coming to Me For Heartwarming’

Forrest Frank Sets Release Date for New Album 'The Jesus Generation'

The 31-date run — the follow-up to Kahan’s string of sold-out The Great Divide World Tour baseball stadium shows in the U.S. this summer — is slated to kick off on April 24 at Sanford Stadium in Athens, Ga., followed by gigs in Tampa, Nashville, Houston, San Francisco and Las Vegas, as well as a four-night stand at Fenway Park in Boston; Kahan played a record-breaking, sold-out four-show run at Fenway this summer that landed him in the Fenway Music Hall of Fame.

Next year’s outing will continue on to Detroit, Montreal and East Rutherford, N.J. before hopping to Europe for summer shows in Berlin, Milan, Paris, Dublin and three nights at Wembley Stadium in London from July 23-25.

Kahan will continue his current tour when he plays the first of two shows at OVO Hydro in Glasgow, Scotland on Nov. 5, followed by U.K. shows in Manchester and London before moving on to Ireland, Switzerland, Germany, Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, Munich and Paris.
